# Cannot compute: CN code missing

The ruleset requires three inputs before a calculation can be made:

| Required input | Provided? |
|---|---|
| (a) Good CN code in the table | ❌ **Missing.** "Steel goods" is not a CN code. |
| (b) Country of production listed for that good | ✅ India (listed for all goods in the table) |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | ✅ 3,000 t |

Default SEE values are selected jointly by CN code and country. For India they range from 2.53 to 4.32 tCO2e/t depending on the good, so "steel goods" does not identify a single factor. Under the ruleset, I cannot estimate or pick one.

## Possible results, depending on the CN code

These figures are for reference only. None is a determination until you confirm the CN code.

| CN code | Good | SEE (India) | Embedded emissions for 3,000 t |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7201 | Pig iron and spiegeleisen* | 2.53 | 7,590.00 tCO2e |
| 7206 10 00 | Ingots, iron/non-alloy steel | 2.64 | 7,920.00 tCO2e |
| 7207 11 90 | Semi-finished products, iron/non-alloy steel | 4.32 | 12,960.00 tCO2e |
| 7214 20 00 | Bars and rods, iron/non-alloy steel, with indentations | 4.27 | 12,810.00 tCO2e |

*Pig iron is generally not considered a "steel" good, but it is included for completeness.

## Next step

Please provide the specific CN code of the goods produced. If the 3,000 t covers more than one good, give the tonnage for each CN code. I will then calculate the embedded emissions, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
